title: Vitess: process-kill chaos + VTOrc auto-reparent
description: Runs `nexus chaos vitess process-kill`: SIGSTOPs a tablet via the embedded nexus-chaos.sh. A replica freezes vttablet; targeting a PRIMARY freezes its mysqld (nexus-mysqlctld) -> VTOrc auto-reparents the shard to a replica -> lift + recover to green.

observe.what: froze a replica vttablet, captured impact, lifted + recovered -> all probes green
froze the 80- primary mysqld; cluster recovered green
VTOrc promoted a different tablet to PRIMARY; the frozen node rejoined as REPLICA

whatProves: VitessAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync SIGSTOPs a single unit per nexus-chaos.sh: a replica vttablet, or a primary mysqld whose freeze triggers VTOrc auto-reparent — the headline HA feature — then lifts and confirms recovery to green.
